The exact 3900-second total is rare, so I will include every playlist meeting at least 3900 seconds and inspect their titles and IDs before choosing one.

```python
exact_matches = [(title, playlist_id) for title, total in playlist_totals if total == 65 * 60]
sufficient_matches = [(title, playlist_id) for title, total in playlist_totals if total >= 65 * 60 and total != 65 * 60]
print({'exact_matches': exact_matches, 'sufficient_matches': sufficient_matches})
```
